eligibility_criteria.age_limit: Grade I Signal: 18 to 36 years; Grade III: 18 to 33 years (Age relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years)
eligibility_criteria.educational_qualification: Grade I Signal: Bachelor of Science in Physics / Electronics / Computer Science / IT / Instrumentation OR 3-year Diploma in Engineering. Grade III: Matriculation (10th pass) plus ITI in specified trade OR 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (for S&T).
